nom: COSRX The Peptide Collagen Hydrogel Eye Patch

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin and eyes report mixed but mostly favorable results, with several saying the patches did not sting or irritate while a couple describe burning sensations and one describes a reaction resembling a chemical burn.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 59s report visible tightening, plumping, and reduced puffiness/fine lines around the eyes.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers (late 30s–59) report tighter, brighter, and plumper-looking under-eye skin and reduced fine lines; no dissent noted on this specific outcome.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers report the under-eye area feels hydrated, plump, and supple after use, including some who compare it favorably to other hydrating patches; one reviewer saw no noticeable difference despite proper placement.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive/rosacea skin reports redness and irritation from another product cleared up after switching to these patches, but several other reviewers report the patches themselves caused redness, burning, or a chemical-burn-like reaction.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the patches caused pimples and another describes a breakout where the patches sat, against a majority who report no such issue.

aspects.libelle: Generous amount of product per jar
Sticky, hard to remove from tub

extraits.texte: I do not have sensetive skin and I use Eye patches now and then. I had used these three time and the 4th time they left me with a HORRIBLE chemical burn . They are not over saturated at all, in fact the are hard to get out of the container and they slide down your face they do not stay in place like others. I put them on one morning while getting dressed. Maybe they were on for 5 to 10 mintues , i was in a hurry and did not have time to let them sit. Thank goodness cause the chemical burn they left for the short time they were on was awuful. It has taken me a week and a half to heal the burn they left. I still havent gotten it all healed. They are horrible.

These would slide off my face, no matter if I tried scrapping off the excess serum. Definitely not for sensitive skin, after 3 minutes it would feel like it was burning and up to 20 minutes after taking them off. After two uses it also caused a breakout where the patches would lay.

Love these under eye patches, they do what they claim. Soothing, refreshing & my over 55 year old eyes look tighter & brighter. Bought when The Sheseido were out of stock & the CORSX are far Superior.
These are slippery little buggers, but they do make a big difference in the skin under my eyes. At 44 my under eye skin is so thin and frustrating, but these help

extraits.titre: I'm 59 and I love these…just buy them.
extraits.texte: Perfect for sensitive eyes. I have tried my brands. These are my personal favorite. Clean ingredients. Great price.

extraits.titre: These are very hydrating and cooling
extraits.texte: I am very happy with this product as a 39 year old with aging skin. It's extremely hydrating and depufs under my eyes. These stay on great while I do laundry if I scrape a little of the serum off.

I experienced an adverse reaction around my eyes to a product from a different brand I that I unknowingly applied without realizing it was expired, so I resorted to using these (as well as other COSRX products) for the days that followed and after few days of using these after my skincare routine, the redness and irritation I had was pretty much gone for good. I ended up putting them in my mini fridge to make them cool to the touch and this definitely made them feel amazing once I applied them to my upper and under eye areas. Sort of like a nice, cool and relaxing resting treatment for the skin around my eyes, so I'll definitely be buying more once I run out of these.
